who.title: Who are we?
who.description: Clé d'Infos is a modern, independent and dynamic digital media platform. Driven by passionate journalists and content creators, we strongly believe in the power of quality information. In a world overwhelmed by rumors and fake news, we aim to be the key that opens the door to truth by providing verified, objective and useful information every day.

mission.title: Our Mission 🎯
mission.item1: Deliver local and international news while covering education, technology, culture and the economy.
mission.item2: Track false rumors and carefully verify facts to ensure only accurate information is published.
mission.item3: Provide a platform where people can share their realities, challenges and aspirations.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.intro: Our ambition for the future is to:
vision.item1: To establish ourselves as the trusted source people naturally turn to for authentic information.
vision.item2: Promote informed and responsible citizens capable of making the best decisions for their future.
vision.item3: Use modern technologies and digital formats to make information more accessible, interactive and engaging.

values.title: Our Values
values.integrityText: We seek the truth and report it honestly.
values.objectivityText: We deliver information in a neutral, balanced and unbiased way.
values.responsibilityText: We understand the impact of our words and images and strictly follow journalistic ethics.
values.respectText: Respect for our readers, our sources and the facts.

team.title: Our Team
team.description: A passionate team working every day to provide reliable and quality information.

cookies.manageText: You can accept, refuse, or delete cookies through your browser settings.

privacy.intro: At Clé d’Infos, we take your privacy and personal data protection seriously.
privacy.collectText: We may collect information such as your name, email address, and browsing data when you use our website.
privacy.cookiesText: Our website uses cookies to improve your experience, measure audience and personalize content.

privacy.protectionText: We implement reasonable measures to protect your information from unauthorized access.
privacy.contactText: For any questions regarding this policy, please use the Contact page.

terms.useText: Information published on Clé d’Infos is intended to inform the public. It must not be used for illegal purposes.
